command: umask 077; mkdir -p "$HOME/.codex" && printf '%s' "$CODEX_AUTH_JSON" > "$HOME/.codex/auth.json" && unset CODEX_AUTH_JSON && exec codex exec --skip-git-repo-check --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox --model gpt-5.6-luna -c 'model_reasoning_effort="max"' "$1"

import base64, datetime, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, time
state = pathlib.Path(os.environ["REVIEWD_CREDENTIAL_STATE"])
if state.name != "auth.json":
    raise RuntimeError("Codex state_file must be named auth.json")
def read_login():
    auth = json.loads(state.read_text())
    if auth.get("auth_mode") != "chatgpt":
        raise RuntimeError("A ChatGPT account login is required")
    return auth
def expiry(auth):
    token = auth["tokens"]["access_token"].split(".")[1]
    return json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(token + "=" * (-len(token) % 4)))["exp"]
auth = read_login()
if expiry(auth) <= time.time() + int(os.environ["REVIEWD_CREDENTIAL_MIN_VALIDITY"]) + 60:
    env = dict(os.environ, CODEX_HOME=str(state.parent))
    proc = subprocess.Popen(["codex", "-c", 'cli_auth_credentials_store="file"', "-c", 'forced_login_method="chatgpt"', "app-server"], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, text=True, env=env)
    def send(message):
        proc.stdin.write(json.dumps(message) + "\n")
        proc.stdin.flush()
    def response(identifier):
        for line in proc.stdout:
            message = json.loads(line)
            if message.get("id") == identifier:
                if message.get("error"):
                    raise RuntimeError("Codex account refresh failed")
                return message["result"]
        raise RuntimeError("Codex ended before account refresh completed")
    try:
        send({"id": 1, "method": "initialize", "params": {"clientInfo": {"name": "reviewd", "version": "1"}}})
        response(1)
        send({"method": "initialized", "params": {}})
        send({"id": 2, "method": "account/read", "params": {"refreshToken": True}})
        result = response(2)
        if (result.get("account") or {}).get("type") != "chatgpt":
            raise RuntimeError("Codex requires ChatGPT account login")
    finally:
        proc.terminate()
        try:
            proc.wait(timeout=5)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            proc.kill()
            proc.wait()
    auth = read_login()
expires = datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(expiry(auth), datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
auth["tokens"]["refresh_token"] = ""
auth["last_refresh"] = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
print(json.dumps({"expires_at": expires, "env": {"CODEX_AUTH_JSON": json.dumps(auth, separators=(",", ":"))}}))
